Welcome to

Merrick East Africa.

Merrick East Africa Medipro was founded on the premise of providing better Healthcare in Africa.

Our team is dedicated to equipping healthcare providers with the best surgicals, advanced wound care and healthcare technologies that enhance patient care. We leverage an extensive sourcing network to acquire specialized medical products and devices.

Our Mission

To advance patient care by expanding access to innovative healthcare technologies.

Our Vision

To be among Africa's leading organizations in transforming patient care through innovative medical technologies, technical expertise and reliable service.

To foster global partnerships that avail the best and latest medtech in our region.

Our Core Values

  • Excellence
  • Growth
  • Integrity
  • Innovation
  • Partnership
